scenarios.description: Terminal middleware writes 13 bytes with Content-Length; no routing.
The plaintext pipeline with 16 requests pipelined per connection (TechEmpower's plaintext depth).
MapGet returning a string, through the router.
MapGet returning a record serialized with a source-generated JSON context.
100 parameterized routes with an int constraint; requests rotate across 10 of them.
Two int parameters bound from the query string; the sum written as JSON.
A 598-byte JSON order bound from the body and echoed back.
A 64 KiB body written in one call with Content-Length.
10 pass-through Use((context, next) => next(context)) ahead of the plaintext terminal.
Nineteen middleware in MIDDLEWARE_ORDER.md order ahead of the json endpoint; every one takes its pass-through path.
Web.SecurityHeaders default policy.
scenarios.note: ASP.NET Core has no security-headers middleware; its side is a hand-written OnStarting middleware writing the same headers.

scenarios.description: X-Forwarded-For/Proto from a loopback proxy applied to the effective client.
Host header checked against a two-entry allowlist.
Plaintext request redirected 307 to https.
Handler throws; the exception boundary writes a 500 problem-details body.
scenarios.note: Dominated by the cost of throwing and catching an exception in either framework.

scenarios.description: A regex rewrite (/legacy/items/42 to /items/42) ahead of routing.
An appended SameSite=None cookie passes through the cookie policy.
An 8 KiB text response gzip-compressed at CompressionLevel.Fastest.
An 8 KiB text response Brotli-compressed at CompressionLevel.Fastest.
A gzip request body (158 bytes, 8 KiB decompressed) read to the end.
A 4 KiB file from wwwroot.
An HS256 JWT validated (signature, issuer, audience, lifetime) on every request.
A data-protected authentication cookie decrypted on every request; each connection signs in once.
JWT authentication plus a role policy on the endpoint.
A POST validated against the antiforgery cookie and header token; each connection fetches its own pair.
A CORS preflight answered by the middleware.
A cross-origin GET that gets Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
A 30-second default request timeout armed and disarmed per request.
A global fixed-window limiter (int.MaxValue permits/minute) consulted on every request.
scenarios.note: Both use System.Threading.RateLimiting's FixedWindowRateLimiter; the difference is the middleware around it.

scenarios.description: A 173-byte urlencoded form with 10 fields parsed; two read.
A response served from the in-memory output cache.
An in-memory session loaded, an int read and written, and committed per request; one session per connection.
A JSON health report with one healthy check.
scenarios.note: ASP.NET Core's side uses UseHealthChecks with a JSON writer, since Cohesion's MapHealthChecks needs no router and writes JSON.

scenarios.description: The OpenAPI document for five typed endpoints.
scenarios.note: Measures each framework's document-serving strategy as shipped (cached or regenerated); the documents are not byte-identical.

scenarios.description: A JSON body bound and validated (3 rules) and accepted.
scenarios.note: Cohesion validates with an ObjectValidation profile; ASP.NET Core with .NET 10's DataAnnotations validation.

scenarios.description: A JSON body that fails validation, answered 400 with problem details.
32-byte text messages echoed over one WebSocket per connection.
scenarios.note: Throughput is messages per second (one round trip each), not HTTP requests.
